candidate.rationale: Checker flagged a linear_resource_effect with no modeled observable output. release_read atomically updates internal rc and performs a ghost-only shared-release; the only semantic effect is consuming the linear ReadHandle. With the current public vstd vocabulary, expressing a non‑vacuous, sound postcondition would require exposing internal tokens/state (rc/inst) or quantifying over concurrent interleavings. Those changes are out of scope, so no useful postcondition can be added.
risks: Callers receive no extra static guarantee beyond consumption of the ReadHandle.
Future verification needing cross-thread invariants will require making lock internals public or adding new ghost resources.
